{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue to numeric, removing commas
data['revenue_numeric'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and remove QA rows: revenue == 999999.99
# These are fake orders and must be excluded
data_clean = data[data['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99]

# Now filter for loyal customers only
data_loyal = data_clean[data_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of converted orders
n_loyal = len(data_loyal)
converted_loyal = data_loyal['converted'].sum()
fraction_converted = converted_loyal / n_loyal

# Print each number explicitly, as required
print(n_loyal)
print(converted_loyal)
print(fraction_converted)"}
